column6: rationale -- scripts/gen-membudget.py; docs/SIZING.md "Memory budgets"; CONTRIBUTING.md "Memory budgets" for flipping an open row.

an aggregate scan that can spill: its group table (held to hash memory at the end of each unit), the results of the finished table, the caches of the values of its expressions (4 MB at most) and one superblock of write buffer rows (6 MB for 1 kB rows); open for two terms that no setting bounds: the table of a parallel scan, which does not spill (34 MB at hash memory 8 MB, agg_par_lanes) and the state of each partition of a partitioned table (67 kB a partition: 81 MB for 1,201 partitions, agg_partitions_many)

the groups of an aggregate scan that cannot spill (a top-N or an order on a key that is not an integer, a date or a timestamp, ordered-set aggregates, grouping sets, a two level aggregate, an ungrouped aggregate): the table grows to the bound of the planner, group_nospill_factor (32) times the larger of hash memory and 8 MB, and ends the scan past it (3.5 MB for 5 groups of a percentile)
the table of a lookup join, hashed by key: 22.8 MB measured, it follows the rows of the dimension table (slope row lookup_join_label)
the inverted buffer of a CREATE INDEX of a search index, its runs and the page of text (9.5 MB held at maintenance_work_mem 1MB: 13.6 MB)
the runs and the inverted buffer of a merge of search segments
the sort of the documents of a sealed segment

the state of a search scan: each open segment holds about 165 kB (a 64 kB dictionary block, its header and stream reader), up to 128 segments (24 MB), plus 8 MB of cursors, candidates and top-N; 0.5 MB at 2 segments, 9.8 MB at 60
the walk of one segment and the heap check of sift.verify: a context for each segment, deleted at its end (before: 115 MB held for 60 segments, now 0.2 MB)
the decoded unit of the sweep of overflow records (4.7 MB)
the two sorts and the window of row hashes of sift.col_verify, each held to maintenance_work_mem (24 MB at the default, 17.6 MB at 4 MB)
the reader of the write buffer of a column index (12.6 MB)
the directory snapshot and the steps of the ambulkdelete and amvacuumcleanup of an index, with the promotions and merges the cleanup runs inside it (8.6 MB at the default maintenance_work_mem)
what one step of the maintenance worker holds besides its promotion or merge, once they end (0.16 MB measured)
the segment read of a value store usage count, reset at each segment (88 kB)
